title: Semaglutide Effects on Insulin Sensitivity and β-Cell Function in Patients With Schizophrenia, Prediabetes, and Obesity Treated With Second-Generation Antipsychotics: Findings From the HISTORI Trial, a 30-Week Randomized, Placebo-Controlled Trial With Semaglutide 1.0 mg Weekly
comparison_or_design: The semaglutide HOMA analysis in SGA-treated participants with schizophrenia.
excluded: Week-15, weight-loss mediation, normal-glucose reference and antipsychotic subgroups
Glucose, insulin, C-peptide, body weight and other parent-trial endpoints
population_or_material: The article-defined HOMA analysis population of SGA-treated participants with schizophrenia, prediabetes and overweight/obesity.
requested_items: Main Table 2 week-30 arm HOMA changes and mixed-model treatment effects/CI/P. Do not substitute complete-data subgroup counts for model analysis n; exclude unreported baseline reconstructions, week-15 and unrelated metabolic outcomes.
case_specific_rules: Retain the requested source-reported HOMA model effects with their own reported CIs. Apply the shared rules for endpoint denominators and unresolved formula or version attributes.
